caveats: All 92 target days and the full 1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05 baseline window (1992-2002 baseline plus 5-day edge extensions) were present in the dataset. 308 land cells of the 3600 region cells have no finite SST on any target day and are reported as 0. Thresholds: per day-of-year (366-day mapping, 31 Dec = 366 in all years, 29 Feb = 60) 90th percentile of the 121-value pool (baseline dates 1992-2002 +/- 5 days), Hyndman-Fan type 5 (numpy hazen), NaN-ignored; 29 Feb filled from mean of 28 Feb and 1 Mar; then a 31-day centred circular moving mean. MHWs: runs of >=5 consecutive days with SST >= threshold, joining gaps of 1-2 days.
